data.name: RTS Outpost
data.detailed_description:
Build your base. Command your army. Conquer a hostile world.

RTS Outpost is a fast-paced online real-time strategy game. Modern military warfare with tanks, jets and heavy firepower, in the spirit of the classic base-building RTS you grew up with.

But the frontier is wild and deadly. Before you can claim new ground, you have to wipe out the creatures that roam it. Construct power plants and war factories, mine resources for credits, roll out tank columns and call in air support. Master the tech tree and out-maneuver real players in real time. Every second counts.

Clear the Wild

The map is overrun with hostile creatures guarding the land. Battle dragons, giant spiders, zombie hordes, man-eating plants and alien UFOs to clear a region before you can expand and build there. Tanks versus monsters versus rival armies. No two battles are the same.

Two Ways to Play

  • Multiplayer Skirmishes: fast RTS battles for 2 to 10 commanders. Build, blitz and be the last base standing.
  • Online Conquest: pick a faction and fight over a living war map. Clear the wilds, capture sectors and hold the front line with your allies, season after season.

Fight with Friends

  • Add friends, see who is online and jump straight into their battle.
  • Team up in 2v2 and 3v3, muster your allies and assault as a squad.
  • Pick a faction and push the front line together.

Climb the Ranks

  • Earn XP, rise through the ranks and top the global leaderboard.
  • Reach number one in your faction to become its Commander, then call the rally to aim the whole faction at a target sector.
  • Storm the rallied sector and ride the morale wave down the front for bonus XP.
  • Earn a permanent Season Commander medal and a public profile tracking your career and battle history.

The Desktop Edition

  • Completely ad-free. One purchase, yours forever.
  • All premium commander avatars unlocked.
  • Steam overlay support and native desktop performance.

Key Features

  • Base Building: power plants, war factories, refineries, defense turrets and missile silos.
  • Modern Arsenal: tanks, infantry, aircraft and devastating heavy units.
  • PvE and PvP: clear deadly creatures, then crush rival commanders.
  • Real-Time Combat: command full armies in real time with flow-field pathfinding.
  • Tech and Strategy: research upgrades and counter every enemy push.
  • Online Multiplayer: battle real players worldwide.
  • Resource Economy: harvest, expand and out-produce your rivals.

Deploy your forces, Commander. The frontier will not clear itself.

data.short_description: Build your base, command your army, and wage real-time PvP war on a living conquest map. Clear a frontier of monsters and alien UFOs, join a faction, team up with friends, and climb the seasonal ranks. A classic base-building RTS with modern military firepower, ad-free on desktop.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 support (Intel HD 5000 or newer)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.recommended:

  • Graphics: Apple Silicon (M1 or newer) or dedicated GPU

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
